title: Compare rooms and rates — structuredContent
description: The `structuredContent` of the `compare_rooms_rates` MCP tool: 2 to 4 room types of ONE property side by side for one stay, for the T-07 inline card row (Figma MVP `D_InLine_Light_T-07` 1630:48658; mobile Set 2 581:47840). Each room is exactly a get_room_rate_details 0.4.0 `room` (README decision 2): the same fields, rates and amenity groups, so MuleSoft builds it from the same upstream calls and the widget reads it with the same code. The MVP has no recommendation block, so PRD's backend scoring fields are left out (decision 1); the model writes its recommendation in the reply, from this data. 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-27). 0.2.0 (2026-10-27): `excluded[].reason` is `not_available` only (README decision 5). 0.3.0 (2026-10-28): reason `over_limit` for the rooms beyond four when `roomCodes` was omitted (decision 8). 0.4.0 (2026-10-28): rooms are T-04 0.4.0 rooms (rates may carry `is_member_rate`).

meta.description: PRD §6 `meta`: the property and the stay that was compared, after server defaults, once per response.

property_name.description: The ENGLISH property name (upstream `propertyName`), as T-04. For the model and the cards' alt text.

brand_code.description: As T-04: the upstream `brand` slug verbatim. Picks the cards' brand panel colour.

asset_base_url.description: As T-01 to T-06: the origin relative image paths resolve against; default https://www.discoverasr.com.

total_results.description: The number of rooms compared: the length of `rooms`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of EVERY price in the response (AC-07): the input's `currencyCode`, or the property's currency when omitted.

checkin_date.description: The stay compared, after server defaults.

checkout_date.description: The widget counts the nights from the two dates.

noOfadults.description: The input's `noOfadults` echoed (after the default): the guests of the one room compared.

childAges.description: The input's `childAges` echoed (as T-06). Sent whenever the input had it.

price_includes_tax.description: The input's `priceIncludesTax` echoed, as T-04. Optional; absent means false.

rooms.description: The compared room types: in the order of the input's `roomCodes` without the excluded ones, or, when `roomCodes` was omitted, the property's first four room types in upstream's own order (T-04's `rooms` order). Each is a get_room_rate_details 0.4.0 `room`: same fields, `rate_plans` filtered and sorted by MuleSoft as there (bookable only, cheapest first). The card's rate dropdown lists `rate_plans`; the Deciding Criteria rows come from `bed_type`, the selected rate's `non_refundable`, and which `amenity_groups` the room has (bathroom, livingroom, kitchen; README decision 6). Always 2 to 4: when fewer than two are left, the server answers `isError` instead (ER-05, EC-04).

excluded.description: Room types left out, so the model can tell the user in its reply (ER-04, ER-07, EC-02, EC-03, EC-06): the widget does not show it. The others are still compared. Optional; absent or empty when every room was compared.

room_code.description: As requested, or the property's own code for an `over_limit` room.

reason.description: "not_available": a requested code with no bookable rate for the stay: either the property has no such room type, or that room has nothing available. Upstream (`apartmentratedetails`) lists only rooms with rates, so the two cannot be told apart without a second call (README decision 5). "over_limit": `roomCodes` was omitted and the property has more than four room types; this one is beyond the first four (PRD AC-04, README decision 8).
